You are helping a developer with Mistral's platform. Answer precisely and cite the documentation pages you used with links.

Is there an endpoint to delete an agent I created with the Agents API?

text: The user asks if there's an endpoint to delete an agent created via the Agents API. I need to check Mistral's documentation for the Agents API reference. I'll search for any delete endpoint or method for agents.

content.text: There is no delete endpoint for an agent in the Agents API. The [Agents API documentation](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/api) covers creating, listing, and retrieving agents, but not deleting them.
